message:
All tests pass now: 2 of 2.

The failure was a wrong expected value in the test, not a bug in the code. `test/vat.test.js` asserted `withVat(250) === 301`. 20% VAT on 250 pence is 50, so the VAT-inclusive price is 300, which is what `src/vat.js` returns. I changed that one assertion to 300 and left the implementation alone. Changing the code to produce 301 would have broken the correct rounding behaviour.

The change is uncommitted in the working tree. If you'd rather keep the original expectation and have the code change instead, tell me and I'll rework it.
